versions.name: Git line marks
versions.summary: Marks the Lines added, changed or removed since a git branch, tag or commit.
versions.description: Pick a branch, tag or commit, and the Grid marks each Line added, changed or removed since then, with a tooltip that names the change. Lines are matched as ASS Events, so a moved or retimed Line reads as changed. Marks refresh after each save and are never written into the file.

permissions.vcs.read: Compares your subtitle file with the branch, tag or commit you pick, to mark the Lines that changed since then.

versions.changelog: - The README no longer names a minimum HikariSub version.

versions.changelog:
- Marks the Grid's Lines added, changed or removed since a git branch, tag or commit, with a tooltip naming the change.
- Matches Lines as ASS Events, so a moved or retimed Line reads as changed, not as removed and added.
- Refreshes after each save and on demand; never writes into the file.
